title: Rick Geary
description: As C-3PO looks on nervously during his holoboard game, he learns from Han Solo that, "It's not wise to upset a Wookiee." They've been known to, "pull peopie's arms out of their sockets when they lose." "Of course, our beloved Chewie would never do anything as nasty as that," muses Rick Geary, "except maybe in our imaginations." Geary has been a regular contributor to NATIONAL LAMPOON, HEAVY METAL, CHEVAL NOIR, DARK HORSE PRESENTS and THE NEW YORK TIMES BOOK REVIEW. He adapted GREAT EXPECTATIONS, WUTHERING HEIGHTS and THE INVISIBLE MAN for Classics Illustrated. His graphic stories have been collected in AT HOME WITH RICK GEARY, WONDERS AND ODDITIES, HOUSEBOUND and PRAIRIE MOON.
